episode.request_text: Hey, I'm after some UHT milk, the ready to drink kind, and it's got to come in cans (I'll check the label myself, don't worry). And it should be something y'all actually have on hand there, not just listed on a website somewhere out past the trailhead. Nothing over 145 cts, because yes, every penny counts for me (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves), so I'm watching the climb on price. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). My cousin asked me to grab some for our Saturday trail breakfast (she's particular, bless her), so I won't guess.

episode.request_text: My roommate Dana asked me to grab one for her since mine has held up fine through two winters (don't tell her I said that). So the thing is a hoodie or sweatshirt, and the material's got to say cotton on the tag (I'll be checking that label, don't you worry), none of that mystery blend trail mix. And it ought to be something y'all really have on hand right now, not just a pretty picture on a site somewhere that's gone by the time I get there. Price tops out at 430 cts, not a cent past that (yes, every penny counts for me), y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). I'm a broke student and she's covering the cost, so anything that fits the trail of her request works for me.

episode.request_text: Every Sunday I lay the week's outfits on my bed (yes, I'm that organized), mostly thrifted tops and hand-me-down skirts that don't match each other. Mules are the thing, and the heel has to be a wedge (I'll check the listings myself, don't you worry), so don't hand me a block heel or a stiletto and call it close. I reckon how the wedge mules look across the surface will decide whether they fit in with that mess. Nothing over 665 cts, y'all (every penny counts when you're a student, and the loans ain't gonna pay themselves), so anything past that is off the trail for me. And I only want pairs y'all actually have on hand, not ones that just show up on some website and then turn out to be a mirage (a trail that fades out halfway up the ridge). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

episode.request_text: Snag first: the last jacket I ordered looked nothing like its photo once I unfolded it, and the return postage ate my grocery money. This time it's a military-style bomber, and I'll wear it over whatever's clean (my roommate says my closet is a trail with no markers). Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. What the cloth itself looks like up close is where I get skeptical, fair or not. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Bomber jackets are the trail I'm on, and the style should be military (I'll look it over myself, don't you worry). And it ought to be something y'all actually have sitting on a shelf, not just a listing floating around on some website somewhere. Nothing over 1900 cts, y'all (every penny counts, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Past that number the climb gets too steep for me.

episode.request_text: Up at my Tennessee college, I've got a scholarship banquet where I'll be shaking hands and getting photographed (first time for me, y'all). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Now, I'm skeptical of most of what's out there, but fair is fair: show me luxury & formal watches in the green color family (I'll check the color myself, don't worry). And it's got to be something you actually have on hand, not just a listing sitting on some website way down the trail somewhere. Price tops out at 2750 cts, not a single one over (every penny counts for me, y'all, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). A green watch ought to look right on my wrist all evening, steady as a well-marked trail.

episode.request_text: Every weekday around seven I trudge up the hill to my first lecture, and my one decent pair of pants finally gave out at the knee. Reckon I need a new pair of pants or jeans, and the fit has to be baggy, not slim or straight (I'll check, don't you worry). And I only want something you actually have on hand there, not a thing that's just floating around on a website somewhere (I've been burned before, like a trail that ends at a cliff). Price cap is 395 cts, y'all, nothing over that (yes, every penny counts for me, student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). I'm a student, so I'm not fussy about anything else (honest, I've worn worse). Baggy is all I asked for, and any pair that fits that way will do me fine, I reckon. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

Our first frost is supposed to land around the second week of November, and I'd like it here before then. Only something you've actually got on hand, not just a listing sitting on a website somewhere. Not a cent over 1250 cts, y'all (every penny counts when you're a student, and loans ain't gonna pay themselves). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). I get paid from my campus job on the 1st, so that's when I'm placing the order. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Any delivery speed is fine so long as it doesn't turn into a long uphill slog of waiting. The closure can be double breasted or zipper and nothing else, sugar.

episode.request_text: Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. My roommate Dana asked me to pick up a clock for our hallway, and she's got feelings about what goes on that wall. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). (I figured a clock's a clock, but I'll be fair, she's lived here longer.) That wall is the first thing folks see coming in, like the overlook at the top of a trail, so whatever I pick sets the tone. Only count what you've got on hand in the store, not what's just listed on some website somewhere (I've been burned by that before). It's a clock I'm after, and the shape's got to be square (I'll check it myself, don't worry, I ain't taking anybody's word on faith). Nothing over 725 cts, y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and every penny counts for me, like every step on a steep climb). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

episode.request_text: Y'all first: I only want something you've actually got on hand, not a listing floating out there like a trail marker to nowhere. I want a skirt, circle style (I'll check the cut myself, don't worry). My roommate Tasha talked me into this, since she swears a skirt like this is the easiest thing to throw on before class. Nothing over 395 cts, y'all (every penny counts, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). I'm a broke college kid, so I'll admit I'm doubtful about most online clothes buying (we'll see if she's right). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Still, I'm ready to take a fair shot, because my closet's a flat trail right now and could use a little climb.

episode.request_text: I'm a little leery of these cleansers, since every label on the shelf swears it fixes something different, like trail signs all pointing opposite ways. So here's what I want: a facial cleanser, and the skin benefit has to be acne care (I'll check the label myself, don't worry). Nothing over 435 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Something you actually have on hand, not just on a website somewhere. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). I'm a student, so I can only afford one bottle this semester (no second tries). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). My roommate says I should just grab whatever's popular, but I'd rather the one I pick suit what my face is actually going through.

episode.request_text: Got a monitor hunt on my hands, and the resolution has to land on 3440 x 1440 (I'll double-check the listing myself, don't worry). And it's got to be one you've actually got on hand there, not one that only exists on some website somewhere down the trail. Nothing over 18000 cts, y'all (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and yes, every penny counts for me). My last order showed up with the wrong cable, so I'm double-checking everything before I spend another dime. This monitor will sit on a desk in my rental room, where I do stats homework, cut video for a class project, and play a few rounds with my cousin on weekends. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). (Yes, I know full well that's a lot of trail for one screen, but it's all I've got.) I'm skeptical of fancy claims, though I'll gladly hear what's honestly worth paying extra for.

episode.request_text: Every Sunday night I lay my clothes out for the week on my bed, and right now there's a gap where this piece would go. So I'm hunting a bomber jacket, and it's got to be sleeveless, no sleeves at all (I'll check the listing myself, don't worry). And it should be something you actually have on hand, not just sitting on a website somewhere out of reach. I'm skeptical of anything that looks pricier than it is (tuition's eating me alive, y'all), but I'll give a fair look to whatever you show me. Nothing over 530 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). My closet's like a trailhead with no signpost right now. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). So I'd be glad of a pointer on which way to head. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
